status: Draft resource descriptors from TASK-005's measurements on the M4 Pro (2026-10-11), for TASK-013 to turn into the luxforge.ai module's resources. Only the model that passed is listed; the text encoder is a separate, optional resource for Replace. Field names follow ResourceDescriptor plus the design's use_restriction and runtime requirements; multi-file resources list their files.

resources.title: FLUX.2 klein 4B, 4-bit, with the object removal LoRA
resources.trade_off: Rebuilds structure and objects behind the region; about 35 s per 512 px candidate and 2.3 min per 1024 px candidate on an M4 Pro; needs 16 GB of memory
resources.provenance: Black Forest Labs FLUX.2 klein 4B (black-forest-labs/FLUX.2-klein-4B@e7b7dc27), quantised to GGUF Q4_0 by leejet (leejet/FLUX.2-klein-4B-GGUF@3b1f5a9d); fal's removal LoRA (fal/flux-2-klein-4B-object-remove-lora@0e3f5879, ComfyUI-converted file); the empty-scene conditioning computed by Luxforge from Qwen3-4B Q8_0 for the LoRA's prompt

files.url_note: Produced by Luxforge, not by a publisher: the prompt 'Remove the highlighted object from the scene' encoded once by Qwen3-4B Q8_0 through the pinned stable-diffusion.cpp (LFSDCOND v1, c_crossattn 512 x 7680 f32). Shipped with the module or hosted by the project; regenerated whenever the encoder, the prompt or the runtime's conditioning changes

runtime.backend: stable-diffusion.cpp master-956-1b0ba10 with ggml d25b121c, Metal
runtime.precision: transformer Q4_0 with bf16 layers, VAE bf16, LoRA applied at multiplier 1.0
runtime.settings: 4 flow steps, CFG 1.0, strength 1.0, masked denoising, the crop with the region outlined in red as the reference image
runtime.minimum_machine_memory_basis: Measured peak process footprint 4.18 to 4.25 GB at 512 to 1024 px with no text encoder; 16 GB proposed so the model, the editor's renderer ceilings and the held candidates fit inside Metal's working-set limit (about 10.7 GB on a 16 GB Mac). Not yet measured on a 16 GB machine

resources.title: Text encoder for Replace (Qwen3-4B, 8-bit)
resources.trade_off: Needed only to type a prompt in Replace; adds 4.3 GB to the download and about 2.4 to 4.2 GB of memory while it is loaded
resources.provenance: Alibaba Qwen3-4B, quantised to GGUF Q8_0 by Unsloth (unsloth/Qwen3-4B-GGUF@22c9fc8a); tokenizer from black-forest-labs/FLUX.2-klein-4B@e7b7dc27

alternative.note: Its removal conditioning scored within 0.22 dB of the Q8_0 one per seed; Replace was inspected with Q8_0 only

runtime.backend: stable-diffusion.cpp, Metal, loaded beside the transformer
runtime.minimum_machine_memory_basis: Measured peak footprint with the transformer: 6.63 GB with the Q4_K_M encoder, 8.4 GB with Q8_0, at 512 px
